_readme: Storefront email previews served at /s/<slug> (noindex, not in the sitemap). Each sales email gets its own slug, so a visit to /s/<slug> is logged against that business by functions/s/[[path]].js. Entries are written by the Storefront tool (amr-storefront track). Images live in public/images/s/ and are never overwritten: a new image gets a new filename. Entries with "example": true are test data, not real businesses.
